title: POOF and Clifford constitutional publication ecology

poof_source_custody.title: The People Outside the Objective Function
poof_source_custody.allowed_use: structural publication mapping and local-authority integration only
poof_source_custody.forbidden_use: private manuscript text cannot serve as the sole support for a public factual assertion

governing_law.statement: Evidence authority moves outward. Challenges move inward. Publication never writes facts backward into the evidence estate.
evidence_outward: canonical receipts, claims, events, identities, surfaces, and reviewed cases
deterministic Clifford compilations and structured reports
POOF passages, Decision Files, REAL STEEL and Steel Mirror projections
challenge_inward: reader, subject, journalist, examiner, accessibility, browser, or machine-audit observation
ordinary Clifford intake, source, selection, temporal, privacy, and human-review gates
canonical correction or evidence change only after normal promotion
no_reverse_authority: POOF prose cannot create a canonical claim
a reader interaction cannot create a finding
a WebsiteIQ score cannot establish substantive truth
a comprehension receipt cannot establish agreement or case truth
REAL STEEL or Steel Mirror similarity cannot define a denominator
MCP or API narration cannot add facts

jurisdictions.label: Report
jurisdictions.function: Stable linear argument compiled from source-addressable projection manifests.
jurisdictions.may: Sequence reviewed evidence, analytical judgments, boundaries, counterevidence, and accepted ceilings.
jurisdictions.may_not: Invent evidence, silently promote a candidate, or hide source and qualification state.

jurisdictions.label: Reader File
jurisdictions.function: Local, contestable record of the reader’s declared role, objective, threshold, inspected objects, route changes, and teach-back.
jurisdictions.may: Support export, erasure, rerouting, comprehension testing, and voluntary challenge submission.
jurisdictions.may_not: Infer motive, ideology, intelligence, agreement, or substantive case truth.

jurisdictions.label: Examination
jurisdictions.function: Interdisciplinary proceedings that expose unresolved propositions, external audits, counterevidence, and repair obligations.
jurisdictions.may: Issue graph-inert referrals naming the required record, test, custodian, and consequence of nonresolution.
jurisdictions.may_not: Bypass canonical promotion or impersonate adjudication not actually performed.

jurisdictions.label: Estate
jurisdictions.function: Durable custody for Person Files, Decision Files, receipts, maps, audits, versions, corrections, counterfactuals, and exit drills.
jurisdictions.may: Preserve conflicting versions and exact release custody.
jurisdictions.may_not: Become an independent factual ledger that diverges from Clifford.

authority_stack.label: Canonical evidence
authority_stack.authority: facts, identities, events, receipts, review state

authority_stack.label: POOF publication projections
authority_stack.authority: argument and presentation bounded by projection manifests

authority_stack.label: Reader, newsroom, examination, and audit interactions
Graph-inert referral intake
authority_stack.authority: research question and acquisition route only

instruments.forbidden_inference: A dossier, actor position, or recurring shape is not a personality score, wrongdoing finding, or neutral denominator.
Differential treatment or ownership does not by itself establish comparable hazards, bad faith, illegality, or hypocrisy.
Passing establishes operational evidence discipline only, not truth, agreement, or publication readiness.
Interface quality, accessibility, discoverability, performance, or machine readability cannot establish a substantive claim.

source_authority: compiled Clifford and POOF projection manifests
instruments.forbidden_inference: Machine narration cannot detach qualifications, infer motive, or create evidence.

release_loop: freeze a reviewed Clifford evidence release
compile POOF Report, Reader File, Examination, Estate, and projection manifests
build human and machine Evidence Desk surfaces
run structural, accessibility, link, MCP, API, and interpretation-contract validation
run cold-reader and newsroom comprehension tests
audit the deployed origin through WebsiteIQ and other external examiners
route publication defects to publication remediation
route substantive objections to graph-inert Clifford referrals
promote evidence changes only through ordinary Clifford review
regenerate POOF from the new frozen evidence release while preserving prior releases

operational_effect_law.statement: Graph-inert is not power-inert. Every transaction must declare each operational effect it may exercise.

constitutional_amendment_law.statement: A constitutional rule may change only through a receipted, migration-aware repository transaction whose consequences remain inspectable.
